rows.en: Touya: "Hm? It's open."
Yamato: "Oh... What's wrong?"
Leone: "Um... Well... I-I want to fight
alongside you too, Touya."
Touya: "We already talked about that..."
Leone: "N-No, that's not what I mean...
I mean... as your partner, Touya,
aboard Rayblade..."
Touya: "Huh? You, as my partner?"
Leone: "I can pilot Rayblade too, you know."
Touya: "Sure you can.
You can handle Eleana, after all.
But what's brought this on?"
Leone: "Would I be a bother?
If you wouldn't mind..."
Touya: "Well..."
Leone: "Oh, I-I'm not asking you to give me an answer.
I just wanted you to know how I feel.
W-Well, see you!"
Yamato: "Leone's been acting awfully girlish lately."
Touya: "Huh?"
Yamato: "Never mind."
Cain: "Cough, cough... Me, beaten by the likes of them... Gah!
!! Wh-What's this...?"
Cain: "I owe you my thanks, Bernst."
Bernst: "You have indeed been reborn.
But you'd be wise not to overuse your 'power.'
Otherwise, you'll lose that life you've regained.
I have no intention of offering my services for free
a second time."
Cain: "Damn it... Not yet. I can't die yet...
Not like this... Rayfon, wait for me...
Soon... for the wrongs done to you... Heh heh heh heh heh..."
Debish: "Goderius has been damaged,
but the path to Vorlia has opened.
Once we have the 'Core', we can do it ourselves..."
Sharl: "..."
Debish: "...What's wrong?"
Sharl: "Those people...
How long do you intend to keep them around?"
Debish: "They have their uses.
We may have Gadran, but even that isn't inexhaustible.
They can at least serve as cannon fodder."
Sharl: "Heh heh heh... Cannon fodder...?
And that woman too?"
Debish: "Oh, you mean Doris?
Well, yes. She's a useful woman. In all sorts of ways..."
Sharl: "..."
Rest: "Excuse me.
We've confirmed the president's whereabouts.
It appears he's definitely at his official residence.
We've also observed Armored Mechs moving
as though they're guarding the residence."
Lodis: "They're not military?"
Rest: "No. Most likely mercenaries."
Lodis: "The ones who previously assaulted the Holy Land,
the ≪Solitary Silver Wings≫?"
Ymir: "Them...
But I don't think they're such bad people.
Perhaps we could make them understand if we talked..."
Celica: "...I doubt it. They're professionals.
They wouldn't break a contract."
Ai: "Right. Taking our side would mean
denying their own identity."
Yamato: "..."
Aurelie: "..."
Ai: "Wh-What?"
Yamato: "...You do come out with some complicated things
now and then, Ai."
Ai: "Oh, you think I'm an idiot, don't you?!"
Fain: "Of course."
Fain: "Oof!"
Ai: "Hearing it from you pisses me off most of all!
...Honestly! How rude!"
Touya: "A-Anyway, we know he's there.
Let's finish this in one go."
Captain Roa: "Right!"
Baren: "...Understood. Set course for 1249, the presidential residence!"
Clovis: "Well, well..."
Arthur: "Quite a grand reception."
Derock: "It's as though they've declared martial law.
A regime that does that will collapse before long."
Xiujian: "But it hasn't collapsed yet.
We must first consider how to deal with the situation before us."
Arthur: "Yes. Let's put on a show until Reamond
takes the president into custody."
Touya: "So, what about the signal?"
Ymir: "Sisk, anything?"
Sisk: "Nothing in particular..."
Miyasco: "...He... will begin moving shortly..."
Sisk: "Huh? Miyasco?"
Miyasco: "...Oh... Huh? I'm sorry, I...
But I definitely have that feeling..."
Celica: "I see. Communication through thought...
A feat possible because they share the same ability, is it?
It's a little hard to believe."
Rest: "This way, the other side won't notice either."
Lodis: "Right. Very well, shall we begin?"
Celica: "Yes! But you're staying behind, brother.
Fermion's maintenance wasn't finished in time."
Lodis: "I see... A pity, but it can't be helped.
Everyone, I'm counting on you!"
Touya: "Yeah! All right, let's go!"
Ai: "Touya. I'll be doing things my own way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll be acting
on my own."
Clovis: "I'll act independently. I'm leaving your side of things to you."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I'm not ready to put my life in your hands yet.
I'll do things my own way."
Xiujian: "...I have no intention of following your orders.
I'll act as I see fit."
Celica: "Sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Fain: "The burning soul of justice does not yet
dwell within you! I cannot follow the orders of such a person!
Therefore, I shall pursue my own justice! That is all!"
Melissa: "I'll be acting on my own this time."
Kururu: "I'll fight however I like."
Leone: "I'm not sure I can follow your orders properly, Touya.
So I'll do things my own way this time."
Horem: "So, they've come after all..."
Steinies: "Hey, are you really sending that guy out?
What if he wakes up halfway through...?"
Horem: "Don't worry. That drug is perfect.
Besides, if anything happens, you can dispose of him."
Steinies: "No thanks. You know how much trouble he gave me earlier...
If you're gonna do it, do it now. Otherwise, don't come crying to me."
Horem: "...I see. Very well.
We still have a trump card."
Steinies: "A trump card?"
Horem: "Heh heh heh heh. It's a secret.
You'll just have to look forward to it."
Steinies: "Tch. Making a big mystery out of it...
Whatever. It's about time I headed out too.
You just sit here and enjoy the show."
Horem: "Heh heh heh... The more foolish they are, the easier they are to control...
Do your best to buy me some time..."
Vel: "Say, Commander... Are we really going to fight?"
Vales: "...It's a contract."
Jono: "This isn't like you."
Vales: "A heartless band of mercenaries.
Wretches who'll side with anyone for enough money...
I didn't care what they called us.
But I ran away from those I should have protected, and now
I'm trying to run away again..."
Vel: "...You mean your daughter and the others...?
But their deaths haven't been confirmed yet."
Jono: "The shop had only collapsed.
No one's confirmed they're dead."
Vales: "It doesn't matter.
Even if they're alive, to those children
I'm no longer their father."
Jono: "Commander..."
Vel: "...That's not true."
Vales: "..."
Vel: "Just as children will always be children to their parents,
parents will always be parents to their children.
When parents abandon that duty, the children lose their way.
What you're saying is nothing but an excuse to run away, Commander.
How can you just stop being their parent?!"
Jono: "Hey..."
Vales: "No, Vel is right...
Perhaps I have been running away.
But it's too late now. For everything."
Vel: "Commander..."
Vales: "This contract isn't with the ≪Solitary Silver Wings≫,
it's with me personally.
You don't have to come along with me."
Jono: "Commander... Don't talk as though we're strangers.
We're coming with you."
Vel: "...It's not fair to keep all the best parts
to yourself.
We can't miss your final performance, Commander."
Vales: "Heh... Admission won't be cheap."
Vel: "Heh."
Jono: "...We knew that from the start."
Vales: "...All right. Let's go!"
Yamato: "Listen, Touya. I'm sure you know this already,
but don't take replenishing your Prana too lightly."
Touya: "Replenishing it?"
Yamato: "The 'kiss'! You know, the 'kiss'! You can't use it right away,
but you can once your Prana's dropped. That one."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... I know."
Yamato: "Really? A girl's lips aren't something
you can take that lightly, you know."
Touya: "I don't want to take it lightly either."
Yamato: "All right, then."
Rest: "Touya. You're the field commander.
I'll follow your orders."
Touya: "Huh?!"
Rest: "Why are you surprised? Our objective is to act as a decoy.
My going off on my own would be poor strategy.
I consider this the best course of action."
Touya: "...Well, if you say so..."
Rest: "Good. I'm counting on you."
Ai: "Ooh, that's a lot of responsibility. Good luck, Commander!"
Kasumi: "You'll be fine, Touya.
Let's do our best together."
Celica: "To think he'd say something like that.
It shows he recognizes your ability, Touya. Heh heh heh heh."
Touya: "Wh-What?! Quit laughing like that!"
Celica: "Ohhh, are you embarrassed?"
Touya: "Hmph!"
Celica: "...Good luck, Touya."
Aurelie: "He thinks highly of you.
You'll have to live up to his expectations."
Melvi: "You're amazing, big brother!
Now you're everyone's commander!"
Leone: "Hey, is that man someone important?"
Touya: "Well, apparently he's practically Agarthia's number one."
Leone: "Wow! For someone like that to say something like that...
That's amazing! You're amazing, Touya!"
Touya: "Aw, well... I'm not that great..."
Yamato: "Don't let it go to your head!"
Leone: "Hee hee hee hee... Let's do our best, Touya!"
Touya: "Y-Yeah."
Ymir: "Everyone, Reamond says he'll begin moving
once only half the Armored Mechs remain."
Arthur: "Half? ...I see.
If the battle turns in our favor, the president will try to flee...
He intends to take advantage of that confusion."
Ymir: "Yes. Fortunately, the military seems to be in disarray,
so they probably won't intervene. But we shouldn't take
too long. It'll be a tough fight, but do your best!"
Touya: "Understood!
All right, let's go!"
Yamato: "...It's taking too long... We should have heard
something by now..."
Touya: "Could something have happened inside...?"
Yamato: "We may have to consider the worst... He might have escaped..."
Ai: "If he gets away now, he'll be even more careful next time...
Touya, we're going in!"
Touya: "Huh?!"
Ai: "We can still make it.
He's the worst possible combination of ambition and power.
Who knows what he'll do next?!"
Touya: "That's true, but..."
Ai: "Oh, come on! Get moving!"
Touya: "Whoa! S-Sit still, will you?!
Gah! Don't move it on your own!"
Kasumi: "Touya... If he gets away here...
will even more people be controlled?"
Touya: "Probably... No, I'm sure they will.
Then he'll use that power to wage war,
then control even more people..."
Kasumi: "That's awful... Isn't there anything we can do?
Something we can do right now..."
Celica: "This is bad... If we don't stop him here,
the damage will only spread... We'll have to face
the controlled Zigrim army, and since he won't need to hide anymore,
he'll carry out his plans openly.
Controlling anyone who won't obey..."
Touya: "...Damn. Then we'll have to go straight
into the residence ourselves..."
Aurelie: "We have to think of something before that happens...
There must still be something we can do!"
Touya: "Yeah. Once we give up, it's over."
Aurelie: "That's right! That's the spirit!
Okay, in that case..."
Melvi: "B-Big brother...
Is everyone going to start acting strange...?"
Touya: "Don't worry. I won't let that happen.
That's why we need to think about what we can do now.
If we give up, it's over."
Melvi: "Okay! I'll think too!"
Touya: "Good, good. That's the way."
Melvi: "Hee hee hee hee hee."
Leone: "Isn't that pretty bad?"
Touya: "Yeah. If he gets away, it'll be hard
to corner that president like this again."
Leone: "What are we going to do? Are we just
going to keep waiting?"
Touya: "No. We could charge in ourselves.
But..."
Leone: "Then there's no need to hesitate.
Let's go, Touya."
Touya: "But it's dangerous, you know?"
Leone: "It's okay. If you think it's the right thing to do,
I'm with you. I trust you, Touya.
The three of us will be fine. We'll work something out."
Yamato: "That's right. Leave it to me!"
Leone: "Ha ha ha ha ha.
Well, now that that's settled..."
Touya: "More reinforcements?!"
Yamato: "It looks a little different from the last one, though..."
Reamond: "...It's over..."
Touya: "!! H-Hey... Why are you...?"
Reamond: "The president is dead. The list of those involved
and the evidence are in trustworthy hands.
We can rest easy now..."
Touya: "I see... Then everything's okay now.
It's all over, right?"
Reamond: "...Yes. Except for me."
Touya: "!? H-Hey, you don't mean...?"
Reamond: "Yes. I'll fight you with everything I have.
Then I'll settle everything."
Touya: "W-Wait! I don't understand any of this!
Why the hell do we have to fight you?!"
Reamond: "...You need a reason...?
Then, for Zigrim's future, I'll eliminate you, who stand in its way,
and His Majesty King Lodis..."
Touya: "Like hell I'm accepting a reason like that!"
Reamond: "That's your problem.
My mind won't change..."
Touya: "This is wrong... It's completely wrong!"
Yamato: "Touya..."
Touya: "...That guy..."
Reamond: "...Then here I come!"
Touya: "Hey, come on. You've gotta be kidding..."
Yamato: "This is bad... But it shows how desperate they are.
We just have to hold out until he takes the president into custody!"
Touya: "Yeah... I'm counting on you, Reamond..."
Horem: "Heh heh heh heh... What was there wasn't everything,
you see... Now, while they're buying me time,
I think I'll make my escape..."
Reamond: "Where are you going,
Your Excellency, President Nell Horem?"
Horem: "...What do you think you're doing, pointing a gun at me,
your head of state?"
Reamond: "Oh? Are you someone worthy of such respect?
At the very least, no citizen would respect you as you are now."
Horem: "Heh heh heh. But the only ones who know me as I am now are you
and Lieutenant Colonel Mishual. You'll both die
in an unfortunate accident... The foolish masses are easy to handle.
They're inferior life-forms who feel safe
as long as they don't lose anything themselves.
Fools who see only the surface of things...
Such easily controlled creatures.
Besides, aren't you barely able to stand right now?
Look, your gun is shaking."
Reamond: "...Yes, my body's probably at its limit.
But before that, you'll answer for your crimes.
Surrender quietly."
Horem: "Crimes... Heh heh heh... If what I've done is a crime,
isn't your very existence a crime as well?"
Reamond: "Yes... I know that.
I'll take you into custody, and afterward
I'll settle things."
Horem: "Oh...? But I'm not a hypocrite
like you..."
Reamond: "...Put that gun away.
Don't make me pull this trigger..."
Horem: "...Heh heh heh heh... You should just pull it already...
I wouldn't hesitate..."
Reamond: "..."
Horem: "Heh heh heh heh... Goodbye..."
Yamato: "Touya, that's... Baresios!"
Touya: "Yeah... But General Growster was
piloting that, right? Then he must be all right."
Yamato: "This isn't the time for that!
Does that look friendly to you?!"
Growster: "..."
Touya: "...Looks like he's being controlled
with that 'drug' after all."
Yamato: "Honestly, that President Horem
is a nasty piece of work!"
Touya: "...Yeah. Using someone like this...
What the hell does he think people are? I won't forgive him."
Yamato: "For now, there's nothing we can do about it.
Let's avoid aiming at the cockpit
and disable the mech."
Touya: "Guess that's our only option..."
Vales: "I've nothing against you, but this is to mark my end.
You'll fall with me..."
Gen: "Heh! If you think you can beat me...?!
Th-This feeling... Somewhere, long ago..."
Vales: "Letting your mind wander in battle...? Hmph!"
Gen: "W-Waaaaaah!"
Touya: "Are you all right?!"
Rosalie: "Hey, Touya! Keep a proper eye on him!"
Touya: "Hey, don't ask the impossible.
Besides, Rosalie, you..."
Vales: "?!"
Gen: "Hm? He stopped moving? Here's my chance!"
Vales: "Grr!"
Gen: "Tch!"
Gen: "Wh-What? He's opening a channel...
Heh. Does that mean he recognizes me as a worthy opponent?
All right, I'll open mine too..."
Vales: "...A child... So it is...
Listen, boy. Tell me your name."
Gen: "Heh heh heh. You've got a good eye, mister,
asking for my name! All right, I'll make a special exception.
My name is... Genzbariored Mercene.
Think you can remember it?"
Vales: "Mercene... I thought so... Heh heh heh...
Genzbariored..."
Gen: "What's wrong, mister?"
Vales: "Nothing. Come on, Gen. Show me
what you can do!"
Gen: "Oh, he cut me off... He sure does whatever he wants...
But... how come he called me Gen...?"
Gen: "Mister!"
Vales: "..."
Gen: "Hey, you can hear me, right?!
Why did you call me Gen just now?"
Vales: "We're in combat.
Don't distract yourself with other things in the middle of a battle!
Concentrate on what's in front of you! Or your back will..."
Gen: "My back...? How do you know about that...?
!! A-Are you... Dad?"
Vales: "..."
Gen: "You're Dad, aren't you?!
You know about the scar on my back..."
Vales: "Your father...
Gaizardingterius Jin Mercene is dead."
Gen: "What are you talking about?! You're my dad, aren't you?!"
Steinies: "Hey, Commander... What's all this dithering?
I'll give you a hand..."
Vales: "!! W-Wait!"
Steinies: "...Oh...? So that little story was true..."
Vales: "I thought this was a private transmission...
That mech has even that capability...?"
Steinies: "I'd prefer you called it surveillance...
But to think you were Crimson Gaius...
Heh heh heh... I've found myself quite a prize..."
Vales: "...You bastard..."
Steinies: "Heh heh... I'll make a name for myself off you...
You know what this machine can do, don't you? Huh?
You've got no choice but to sit there and be beaten!"
Vales: "Grr..."
Gen: "Dad would never lose to the likes of you!"
Steinies: "Heh heh heh... You don't seem to understand
that your very presence is putting your father in this predicament!
He can't move because you're here."
Gen: "What are you talking...?"
Steinies: "If I got serious, I could kill you
first. That's what I mean."
Gen: "D-Dad..."
Vales: "..."
Steinies: "Keh keh keh keh keh."
Gen: "Dad!"
Vales: "Gen..."
Vales: "Gah!"
Gen: "D-Dad! Why didn't you dodge?!
For someone like me..."
Vales: "...I can't let anyone dear to me be hurt
because of me ever again..."
Gen: "...Dad..."
Vales: "...I'm sorry..."
Gen: "Dad!"
Vales: "...You've grown so much... Gen........"
Gen: "D-Dad... Dad... Daaaaaad!!"
Steinies: "Heh heh heh... Keh keh keh keh..."
Vales: "........It's about time...
All right, we're withdrawing!"
Yamato: "Isn't it about time?"
Touya: "Huh? For what?"
Yamato: "The infiltration! The infiltration!"
Touya: "Oh, right. The enemy's numbers are down to half or less now.
Let's shut the rest of them up."
Yamato: "Right."
Touya: "Grr..."
Reamond: "...This is the end..."
Touya: "U... Uwaaaaaah!!"
Reamond: "...Heh..."
Yamato: "Huh? He didn't dodge...?"
Touya: "Y-You... I knew it..."
Reamond: "...Now, everything will end..."
Yamato: "Huh? Griol...?"
Reamond: "Lieutenant Colonel..."
Fores: "Reamond!"
Fores: "You idiot! Going off on your own,
trying to die on your own... How much trouble
do you have to cause me before you're satisfied?!"
Reamond: "You don't have to call me an idiot... I was concerned
about your condition, Lieutenant Colonel..."
Fores: "So you drugged me and put me to sleep?!"
Reamond: "You would've come along if I hadn't, wouldn't you?"
Fores: "Of course! Look at the reckless thing
you're doing right now! Do you know how worried I've been...?"
Reamond: "...Thank you...
But this is goodbye..."
Fores: "Don't just decide it's over!
You're far too selfish... You appeared before me without asking,
started teasing me without asking...
And then... then you made yourself at home in my heart!"
Reamond: "...Those words are all I need...
I'm so glad I met you, Lieutenant Colonel..."
Yamato: "Look out! That mech's about to explode!"
Fores: "..."
Reamond: "L-Lieutenant Colonel, what are you doing?! Get away!"
Fores: "...No."
Yamato: "Are you crazy?!
Opening your cockpit hatch like that!"
Reamond: "Lieutenant Colonel! Close the hatch!"
Fores: "..."
Reamond: "...Grr!"
Yamato: "Ah! It's too late!"
Touya: "...What the hell..."
Yamato: "Touya! Look!"
Reamond: "...Honestly... You're a reckless woman..."
Fores: "That makes two of us."
Reamond: "Heh heh heh... Quite right. Quite right..."
Touya: "...Looks like they're safe."
Yamato: "Yes. And things outside are taken care of too. That's that!"
Steinies: "Keh keh keh keh... What a farce...
Well, whatever. If he's croaked, I suppose it's all over.
...But I'm still here...
You don't get to experience a battle like this very often!
Heh heh... It's been ages since I've felt this thrill... Keh keh keh!"
Yamato: "Touya, it's too soon to relax!"
Zigrim Soldier: "...Ugh..."
Touya: "Huh?"
Zigrim Soldier: "........Wh-Where am I...?"
Yamato: "Oh! Looks like he's come back to his senses!"
Touya: "Yeah. For now, it looks like we were right
not to fight a pointless battle..."
Yamato: "Touya, it's too soon to relax!"
Growster: "...Ugh..."
Touya: "Huh?"
Growster: "........Wh-Where am I...
Hm? That's Rayblade..."
Yamato: "Oh! Looks like he's come back to his senses!"
Touya: "Yeah. For now, it looks like we were right
not to fight a pointless battle..."
Yamato: "...It's taking too long... We should have heard
something by now..."
Touya: "Could something have happened inside...?"
Yamato: "We may have to consider the worst... He might have escaped..."
Ai: "If he gets away now, he'll be even more careful next time...
Touya, we're going in!"
Touya: "Huh?!"
Ai: "We can still make it.
He's the worst possible combination of ambition and power.
Who knows what he'll do next?!"
Touya: "That's true, but..."
Ai: "Oh, come on! Get moving!"
Touya: "Whoa! S-Sit still, will you?!
Gah! Don't move it on your own!"
Kasumi: "Touya... If he gets away here...
will even more people be controlled?"
Touya: "Probably... No, I'm sure they will.
Then he'll use that power to wage war,
then control even more people..."
Kasumi: "That's awful... Isn't there anything we can do?
Something we can do right now..."
Celica: "This is bad... If we don't stop him here,
the damage will only spread... We'll have to face
the controlled Zigrim army, and since he won't need to hide anymore,
he'll carry out his plans openly.
Controlling anyone who won't obey..."
Touya: "...Damn. Then we'll have to go straight
into the residence ourselves..."
Aurelie: "We have to think of something before that happens...
There must still be something we can do!"
Touya: "Yeah. Once we give up, it's over."
Aurelie: "That's right! That's the spirit!
Okay, in that case..."
Melvi: "B-Big brother...
Is everyone going to start acting strange...?"
Touya: "Don't worry. I won't let that happen.
That's why we need to think about what we can do now.
If we give up, it's over."
Melvi: "Okay! I'll think too!"
Touya: "Good, good. That's the way."
Melvi: "Hee hee hee hee hee."
Leone: "Isn't that pretty bad?"
Touya: "Yeah. If he gets away, it'll be hard
to corner that president like this again."
Leone: "What are we going to do? Are we just
going to keep waiting?"
Touya: "No. We could charge in ourselves.
But..."
Leone: "Then there's no need to hesitate.
Let's go, Touya."
Touya: "But it's dangerous, you know?"
Leone: "It's okay. If you think it's the right thing to do,
I'm with you. I trust you, Touya.
The three of us will be fine. We'll work something out."
Yamato: "That's right. Leave it to me!"
Leone: "Ha ha ha ha ha.
Well, now that that's settled..."
Touya: "More reinforcements?!"
Yamato: "It looks a little different from the last one, though..."
Reamond: "...It's over..."
Touya: "!! H-Hey... Why are you...?"
Reamond: "The president is dead. The list of those involved
and the evidence are in trustworthy hands.
We can rest easy now..."
Touya: "I see... Then everything's okay now.
It's all over, right?"
Reamond: "...Yes. Except for me."
Touya: "!? H-Hey, you don't mean...?"
Reamond: "Yes. I'll fight you with everything I have.
Then I'll settle everything."
Touya: "W-Wait! I don't understand any of this!
Why the hell do we have to fight you?!"
Reamond: "...You need a reason...?
Then, for Zigrim's future, I'll eliminate you, who stand in its way,
and His Majesty King Lodis..."
Touya: "Like hell I'm accepting a reason like that!"
Reamond: "That's your problem.
My mind won't change..."
Touya: "This is wrong... It's completely wrong!"
Yamato: "Touya..."
Touya: "...That guy..."
Reamond: "...Then here I come!"

review_batches.context: Read complete597-row member and preceding optional visits. Leone requests Rayblade partner role; separate Cain/Bernst and Debish/Sharl scenes precede residence assault briefing and mercenary identification.
review_batches.decisions: Keep nonexplicit partnership request unanswered, attributed rebirth/power warnings, unfinished vengeance remark, Core/Vorlia distinction and unspecified Gadran finite capacity. Cannon-fodder dehumanization retained, Doris usefulness left unspecified. Preserve marked group name56 and every source row; report versus confirmed external fact separated.
